description:
Configure offline payment methods for B2B wholesale orders. 

1. Enable 'Bank Transfer Payment':
   - Title: 'Wire Transfer / ACH'
   - Instructions must include:
     Bank: First Example Bank
     Routing: 021000021
     Account: 9876543210
     Please include your Order Number in the wire reference.
   - Sort Order: 10

2. Enable 'Check / Money Order':
   - Title: 'Corporate Check'
   - Make Check Payable to: 'TechCorp Solutions'
   - Send Check to: '123 Tech Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94107'
   - Sort Order: 20

Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Payment Methods to apply these settings. Save the configuration when done. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
